content:
The highly anticipated Apple TV+ series "Ted Lasso" Season 4 is currently in full swing, and audience reactions have been very enthusiastic — but the platform still has three exciting new series launching soon.

Series One: "Dark Matter"

Apple TV+ boasts a vast library of series, and fans of sci-fi can binge to their heart's content. "Severance" and "Pluribus" have already become the talk of the town, but there's another beloved series you may have overlooked: "Dark Matter".

The series is adapted from Blake Crouch's bestselling novel and stars Joel Edgerton and Jennifer Connelly.

"Dark Matter" Season 2 will premiere on Friday, August 28, with new episodes released weekly until October 30.

Here is the synopsis provided by Apple:

Series Two: "Mayday"

Apple TV+'s fall slate is quite robust, with most titles heading straight to the streaming platform rather than getting a theatrical release first.

Kicking things off is "Mayday", an action comedy starring Ryan Reynolds and Kenneth Branagh, bringing a fresh twist to the classic spy thriller genre.

"Mayday" will premiere exclusively on Apple TV+ on Friday, September 4.

Here is the synopsis and trailer provided by Apple:

Series Three: "Slow Horses"

One of Apple's most acclaimed series, "Slow Horses", is making a strong comeback.

In the streaming era, audiences often have to wait several years for a new season of their favourite shows. But "Slow Horses" has maintained an annual release cadence, with Oscar-winning actor Gary Oldman reprising his role as Jackson Lamb to lead the team through another gripping spy story.

"Slow Horses" Season 6 will premiere on Wednesday, September 16, with new episodes released weekly until October 21.

Apple TV+ costs US$12.99 per month, and discounted bundles are also available through Apple One subscriptions.
